workflow: An owned isolated AutoCAD 24.3 scratch process runs A3 Layout 1:1, A4 Window 10,20-190,270 at 1:2, DWG reopen, Extents Fit Center, an out-of-sheet Window -25,-40-275,360, Display from the exact captured Chromium paper view and restored A3 Layout.
result: AutoCAD preserved viewport coordinates, persisted A4 Window/1:2, accepted arbitrary Window coordinates and Display, rejected CenterPlot for Layout and emitted two independently parsed PDFs. Native VIEWCTR/VIEWSIZE/SCREENSIZE reproduced the Chromium Display source within 0.01 drawing units; both native vectors matched their resolved scale. Absolute PC3 printable margins remain F-108. The owned PID terminated, the pre-existing AutoCAD process set was restored and temporary files were removed.
